repeat.authority: Searched: Minn. Stat. §§ 13.03, 13.04 (full text); Minn. R. ch. 1205; DPO guidance
repeat.notes: No repeat-request carry-forward or fee-aggregation rules found in ch. 13, the 1205 rules, or DPO guidance. The subd. 3(g) suspension (MN-9001) operates per-request and does not aggregate across requests. Absence of a found rule is not proof none exists.

fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: For requests of 100 or fewer black-and-white letter/legal-size paper copies, actual costs may not be used; the entity may charge no more than 25 cents per page copied.
When a data subject requests copies of data about themselves, the responsible authority may require payment of the actual costs of making and certifying the copies.
fee.copy_rate_per_page.clock_spec: ceiling: actual cost of making and certifying copies

fee.labor_charge.summary: When copies or electronic transmittal are requested, the responsible authority may require payment of the actual costs of searching for and retrieving the data, including employee time.
fee.labor_charge.clock_spec: ceiling: actual cost (search + retrieval + employee time)

custody.custodian_definition_and_role.summary: Requests are made to, and must be acted on by, the responsible authority or its designee.

custody.records_officer_designation.summary: Each government entity must designate an employee to act as its data practices compliance official to handle questions and problems regarding access to data.

intake.procedures_publication.summary: Each government entity's responsible authority must establish procedures to ensure requests for government data are received and complied with in an appropriate and prompt manner.

classification.presumption_of_openness.summary: All government data is public unless classified by statute, temporary classification, or federal law as not public (nonpublic/protected nonpublic, or, for data on individuals, private or confidential).
